title: Split vasp reader into smaller bits: Configuration vs whole POSCAR/CONTCAR
body:
This separates CHGCAR from POSCAR/CONTCAR responsibilities.

 * read_vasp() works as currently but is easier to read
 * CHGCAR reading no longer calls the full read_vasp() but only attempts to read the atomic configuration, and will not need to decide whether it wants to read the velocities which are not there anyway.
